cases.name: Jennifer Jo Loman Blagg
cases.about:
She was a stay-at-home mom with a deep faith in God. She was described as a loving mother who volunteered in her daughter’s first grade class multiple times a week, did Jazzercise and used to go walking in the mall. She was the type of person who would call her mom almost every day, started Christmas shopping in early November and went to church every Sunday with her husband and 6-year-old daughter.

cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Cynthia graduated from Grand Junction High School and dedicated her life to caring for others as a Certified Nursing Assistant for many years. Her compassion and dedication touched the lives of everyone around her. She had a remarkable ability to make everyone feel included and comforted, embodying the essence of love and care.

Cynthia had a passion for traveling, gardening, reading, and watching horse shows. These activities brought her immense joy and allowed her to connect with the beauty of the world around her."
